title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 508  An Act Converting the Talabutab Norte Barangay High School in the Municipality of General Mamerto Natividad, Province of Nueva Ecija, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Talabutab Norte National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 508  An Act Converting the Talabutab Norte Barangay High School in the Municipality of General Mamerto Natividad, Province of Nueva Ecija, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Talabutab Norte National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Talabutab Norte Barangay tại Thị trấn General Mamerto Natividad, Tỉnh Nueva Ecija thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Talabutab Norte Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Talabutab Norte Barangay ในเทศบาล General Mamerto Natividad จังหวัด Nueva Ecija เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Talabutab Norte แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Talabutab Norte Barangay di Kotamadya General Mamerto Natividad, Provinsi Nueva Ecija menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Talabutab Norte Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Talabutab Norte Barangay di Perbandaran General Mamerto Natividad, Wilayah Nueva Ecija kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Talabutab Norte Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Talabutab Norte Barangay High School in the Municipality of General Mamerto Natividad,
Province of Nueva Ecija, is converted into a national high school to be known as the Talabutab Norte National
High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
